title: Lattice Deduction Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.08605v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the Lattice Deduction Transformer (LDT), a recurrent transformer that approximates logically sound deduction by projecting its latent state through a lattice between forward passes. We train on-policy in a process that mirrors deduction in a search-based constraint solver and supervise training via a domain-agnostic approximation of the set of solution candidates based on abstract interpretation. An $800$K-parameter LDT outperforms prior small recurrent reasoners on Sudoku-Extreme with under $2\%$ of their estimated training FLOPs, solving $99.999\%$ of the $422{,}786$ test puzzles. The model is nearly always sound, in that it gives a wrong answer for $4$ of $1.27$M puzzle evaluations, and otherwise returns a correct answer or abstains. A $1.8$M-parameter LDT variant reaches $99.8\%$ accuracy on Maze-Hard. Our code is available at github.com/lcrh/lattice-deduction-transformers.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了格演绎Transformer（LDT），这是一种循环Transformer，通过在前向传递之间将其潜在状态投影到一个格上，来近似逻辑上可靠的演绎推理。我们在一个与基于搜索的约束求解器中的演绎过程相镜像的流程中进行在线训练，并通过基于抽象解释的、与领域无关的解候选集近似方法来监督训练。一个80万参数的LDT在Sudoku-Extreme（极难数独）基准上超越了以往的小型循环推理模型，且训练所需的估计浮点运算量不到后者的2%，解决了422,786个测试谜题中的99.999%。该模型几乎总是可靠的：在127万次谜题评估中仅给出4次错误答案，其余情况要么返回正确答案，要么选择弃权。一个180万参数的LDT变体在Maze-Hard（高难度迷宫）上达到了99.8%的准确率。我们的代码发布于 github.com/lcrh/lattice-deduction-transformers。
tldr: 格演绎Transformer（LDT）通过在前向传递之间以格投影潜在状态来近似逻辑可靠的演绎推理，仅用80万参数和不到现有模型2%的训练计算量，就以近乎完全可靠的方式解决了99.999%的极难数独谜题。
en_tdlr: The Lattice Deduction Transformer (LDT) approximates logically sound deduction by projecting its latent state through a lattice between forward passes, solving 99.999% of Sudoku-Extreme puzzles with only 800K parameters and under 2% of prior models' training FLOPs while remaining almost always sound.
